facts.name: Goat's Beard
facts.light: Part shade to shade; best in light shade, takes some sun if the soil stays moist
facts.notes: A shrub-sized perennial with feathery plumes in June, like a giant astilbe. Native to the eastern U.S. Give it room at the back.

sources.title: Bordine's (Michigan garden center): perennials by bloom time, 2026
sources.note: Current perennial list from a Michigan garden center.

companions.why: Combines well with astilbe, columbine and ferns; plant with wild ginger, Virginia bluebells, Jacob's ladder and wild geranium; mix with iris.
